day name: Holy Fathers of the Seventh Ecumenical Council.
name: Holy Fathers of the Seventh Ecumenical Council
troparia: (Tone 8) Christ our God, You are glorified above all,* You established our fathers as beacons on earth* and through them guided all of us to the true faith.* Glory to You, most compassionate Lord.
kontakia: (Tone 6) The Son who ineffably shone from the Father* was born two-fold of nature from a woman.* Beholding Him, we do not reject the image of His form;* but depicting it, we revere it faithfully.* Therefore the Church, holding the true faith,* kisses the icon of Christ’s becoming man.
